description: This file defines the internal sealed class SocketConnectionListener which implements the IConnectionListener interface. It manages TCP socket listening, including binding, accepting connections, and unbinding, with configurations for keep-alive, fast path, and dual mode, specifically designed for network connection handling within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: SocketConnectionListener
classes.description: Manages TCP socket listening, accepting incoming connections, and resource cleanup within the Orleans networking framework.

methods.name: SocketConnectionListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener with endpoint, options, trace, and schedulers, setting up the memory pool.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Creates and configures the listening socket, binds it to the endpoint, and starts listening for incoming connections.

methods.name: AcceptAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously accepts incoming socket connections, configures accepted sockets, and creates corresponding connection objects.

methods.name: UnbindAsync
methods.description: Disposes of the listening socket, effectively unbinding the listener.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes of resources including the listening socket and memory pool.
